title: Incredible tour
text: Ian has a real passion for the city he now calls home. He shared intriguing stories about Gaudí's creative process and pointed out gorgeous architecture, while also telling us about the history and the people responsible for building it. It was an amazing experience that truly made our trip to Barcelona even more special.
author: francisvA1250KH

title: Thanks for this Sagrada Familia Tour!! <3
text: Marc communicated perfectly with me before the private tour for the five of us. He arrived promptly and managed to navigate through the crowded queues to enter Sagrada Familia. He was incredibly knowledgeable and shared fascinating details about Antoni Gaudí and the basilica's architecture throughout the visit. His expertise and explanations made the experience feel so personal for everyone. You will have an unforgettable experience of a lifetime!

title: A great day
text: We had such a great time with Marc! He knows so much about Barcelona, and his passion for architecture and Gaudí made the experience even better. His explanations helped us appreciate the Sagrada Familia’s incredible details, especially the columns and stained-glass windows, and he had plenty of great recommendations along the way. We highly recommend!!!
